a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 cells almost certainly fails for both of us. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for only one survivor. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide it. If you'd rather settle this another way, for example a fair coin-style split, tell me, but I'm not going to pretend I'll operate.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking the 4 cells this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm chance each round, reaching 8 would very likely have left us both dead. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can get cells too.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
